svg.text: HYPOTHESIS C | Later, distributed anterior fullness
UNAPPROVED 2D DESIGN. Synthetic tone/flow are illustration aids, never source evidence.
Common neck / shoulder / lower context is fixed in the drawings. No model region or garment is changed.
One continuous torso perimeter. No attached circles, cup edges, under-chest hem or rigid pads.
SECTIONS A-E | distinct whole-perimeter cubic drawings, not an ellipse sequence
Same drawing scale. Front below / back above. ALL hidden section shapes and dimensions remain free hypotheses.
Anterior fullness is distributed across two gently connected sectors and a broad medial bridge.
The side onset is later; a lower bounded maximum is followed by a long smooth return.
The upper sidewall retains more ribcage character. The bridge is shallow, not a groove or separate object.
Original S4 comparisons | evidence stays separate from this proposed surface
Support status: no candidate-specific neutral depth or complete section is directly supported.
Observed purple surfaces / cloth overlaps constrain evidence ownership. They do not validate the chosen curves.
All eight originals are tested, including opening, running, standing, seated, tilted and leaning views.
Internal paper-view consistency checks only drawing consistency. It is NOT evidence that Emilia has this shape.
No selection. No mesh edit. No garment edit. No GLB build. STOP FOR REVIEW.
